correctness.rationale: For all t∈C* reduced septic f_t=(x²+y²−tz²)(x²−z²)(y²−z²)(x+y), fixed five-line arrangement has four nodes and two triple points. Its added smooth conic has ten Bezout line intersections; generic gives 14A1+2D4 (τ22), at t=1 four line-conic tangencies give 6A1+4A3+2D4 (τ26), t=2 conic passes four square corners giving 2A1+2D4+2X9 (τ28); discriminants t−1 and corner condition t−2 exhaust exceptions t≠0. Exact source determinant witnesses for degree3 Jacobian map have factors t^8(t−2)^3(t−1)^8(t+1) and t^7(t−2)^3(t−1)^8, so their common zeros away from t0 only t1,2. The source universal degree4 explicit relation gives generic mdr4. At t1 source degree3 relation and nonzero degree2 full-column 18-minor give mdr3; t2 source degree2 relation and nonzero degree1 full-column 9-minor give mdr2. Applying standard free/nearly-free numerical criteria for degree7 yields t2 free exponents(2,4) and t1 nearly-free(3,4); generic neither. Independent exact matrices reproduce ranks at t1 (Φ1=9, Φ2=18, Φ3=29), t2 (Φ1=9, Φ2=17) and t3 (Φ3=30, Φ4=43). Uniform conclusions derive from factorized polynomial minors, not isolated t samples.

originality.rationale: Gałecka section 5.5 gives the t=1 nearly-free septic with the identical six nodes, four tacnodes and two triple points; that specialization is correctly attributed as prior, not new. Her primary 2022 paper does not treat varying t, show the generically nonfree behavior or reveal a free t=2 fiber with two X9 points. Related Resultary degree-eight near-free conic-line example uses a different polynomial and combinatorics; Dimca supplies free/near-free criteria but not exact pencil discriminants. Complete transition remains new best-of-knowledge.
